notes.title: Counter Agents Update and ConSPYration Announcement!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce an update for Counter Agents!

This patch includes:


 Upgraded Lighting.
 Upgraded VFX.
 Updated input system to allow additional options for controller support.
 Performance improvement.
 General UI updates and quality of life improvements.


The developers behind Counter Agents are also thrilled to announce "ConSPYration", a new fast paced local multiplayer stealth game directly inspired by Counter Agents! Check it out on Steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485890/ConSPYration/
